records.description: Bldg 3 Unit 370- NEW ABOVE-GROUND LP (PROPANE) GAS PIPING INSTALLATION COMMERCIAL ROASTING EQUIPMENT. This is a standalone new-work trade permit (gas piping) NOT a repair permit. No existing gas piping is being repaired replaced or altered; this is new piping to a newly installed appliance. PURPOSE: Install new above-ground LP gas piping to supply a commercial coffee roaster (IMF RM-15A_STD manufacturer data sheet Doc ST_00) inside the modular building at this address. Piping runs from the roasters gas train inlet connection to a new exterior termination stub at the rear exterior wall of the modular building. The exterior stub is a dead-end termination point only valved and capped for future connection by the propane supplier. Contractor scope ends at the exterior stub; it does NOT include the propane tank exterior regulators or any underground/trenched piping from the tank to the stub; that work is performed separately by the propane supply company. WORK DIMENSIONS: Total piping run approximately 25 to 35 feet (35 ft design basis) routed above ground through the rear interior of the modular building to an exterior wall penetration terminating at an exterior stub at the rear of the building. Pipe size: 3/4 in nominal Schedule 40 black steel trunk line reduced to 1/2 in NPT at the roasters gas train connection. Scope includes: pipe sizing and installation appliance shutoff valve at the roaster union sediment trap (drip leg) wall penetration with sleeve and seal exterior stub termination (valved and capped) pressure test and leak test of all new piping and coordination of required city inspections. No underground piping by the applicant.
